description: Third-party core (STMicroelectronics:stm32) with a non-empty core_url. Explicitly named by spec/design.md's Verification Strategy as the golden-path regression board (AC-001-011). HEAVIER than uno-r3/nano-r4: the STM32 core is not pre-installed in a stock dev environment, so run_setup triggers a real network core-manager-URL fetch + core install on first run, in addition to the compile in run_verify. Expect several extra minutes versus the 'cheap' cases; run with --boards nucleo-f411re --timeout 900 in isolation the first time.
